map.Mayo 评分 = 排便次数 + 便血 + 内镜表现 + 医师评价（各 0 至: Mayo score = sum of stool frequency + rectal bleeding + endoscopic findings + physician assessment (each 0 to 3), max 12; the partial Mayo score excludes endoscopy (0 to 9); <2 remission, 3–5 mild, 6–10 moderate, 11–12 severe.

map.内镜缓解定义：Mayo内镜亚评分=0。深度缓解定义：临床缓解+内镜缓解。: Endoscopic remission definition: Mayo endoscopic subscore = 0. Deep remission definition: clinical remission + endoscopic remission.

The Mayo score can also monitor treatment response, with clinical response defined as a score drop ≥3 points and ≥30% reduction. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：溃疡性结肠炎 Mayo 评分: 📚 Deep Dive: Ulcerative Colitis Mayo Score
map.活动度评估：由排便、便血、内镜、医师评估 4 项算 0~12 分: Activity assessment: compute 0~12 points from the 4 items of stool frequency, rectal bleeding, endoscopy, and physician assessment
map.缓解界定：内镜缓解与深度缓解是近期治疗目标: Remainder definition: endoscopic remission and deep remission are near-term treatment goals
map.算法：排便次数(正常/+/1~2/+/3~4/+/≥5 计 0~3)、便血(无/: Algorithm: stool frequency (normal/+/1~2/+/3~4/+≥5 counts 0~3), rectal bleeding (none/trace/obvious/predominantly blood 0~3), endoscopy (normal/mild/moderate/severe 0~3), physician assessment (normal/mild/moderate/severe 0~3), summed to a Mayo total of 0~12; partial Mayo = stool frequency + rectal bleeding + physician assessment. ≤2 remission, 3~5 mild, 6~10 moderate, >10 severe.
map.例：排便 2 分、便血 2 分、内镜 2 分、医师 2 分 → 总分 8 分，中: Example: stool frequency 2, rectal bleeding 2, endoscopy 2, physician 2 → total 8, moderate activity (≤10); systemic steroids or biologic evaluation is advised. If all items score 1 → total 4, mild activity (≤5), oral 5-ASA plus topical suffices. If all score 3 → total 12, severe activity (>10); hospitalization, IV steroids, and switching to cyclosporine/infliximab if no response in 48~72h are advised.
map.部分 Mayo 评分有什么用？: What is the partial Mayo score used for?
map.部分 Mayo 不含内镜项，便于门诊快速评估且避免频繁肠镜，常用于临床试验与远程: The partial Mayo excludes the endoscopy item, enabling quick outpatient assessment and avoiding frequent colonoscopy, and is often used in clinical trials and remote follow-up; but determining endoscopic remission must rely on the complete Mayo (with endoscopy).
map.Mayo ≤2 且单项 ≤1 传统定义为临床缓解，但「深度缓解」还要求内镜无活动: Mayo ≤2 with each item ≤1 is traditionally defined as clinical remission, but deep remission additionally requires no endoscopic activity (endoscopic subscore 0). Symptom-only remission with ongoing endoscopic inflammation has a high relapse rate, so treatment targets should point to endoscopic/histologic remission.
